(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define ctrl (third (first (filter (lambda (cell) (let ((v (third cell))) (and (>= v 1) (<= v 3)))) (grid-cells g)))))
    (define (border-cells obj)
      (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                              (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
              (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (and (= (obj-color obj) 4)
                                       (equal? (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<?) (sort (border-cells obj) cell<?))))
                    (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define idx (- ctrl 1))
    (define selected (and (< idx (length frames)) (list-ref frames idx)))
    (define inner (and (< (+ idx 1) (length frames)) (list-ref frames (+ idx 1))))
    (if selected
        (let* ((inside (positions-in-rect (+ (obj-r1 selected) 1) (+ (obj-c1 selected) 1)
                                          (- (obj-r2 selected) 1) (- (obj-c2 selected) 1)))
               (fillable (filter (lambda (p)
                                    (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                                         (or (eq? inner #f)
                                             (not (and (>= (first p) (obj-r1 inner)) (<= (first p) (obj-r2 inner))
                                                       (>= (second p) (obj-c1 inner)) (<= (second p) (obj-c2 inner)))))))
                                  inside)))
          (paint-cells g fillable 8))
        g)))
